newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGS-Thomsom sees no change in shareholding.
newsitem.headline: SGS-Thomsom sees no change in shareholding.

text.p: SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV president and chief executive Pasquale Pistorio said on Wednesday that he did not see any pending changes in the company shareholder structure.

He told a news conference on the company 1996 results that contrary to some newspaper reports, Industry Minister Franck Borotra had not informed him of any pending changes in the French shareholding group which has an indirect 35 percent stake in the company.
"I do not see any changes." Pistorio said.
"I met Borotra in Strasbourg last year. We did not discuss the shareholding structure."
